summary: The legacy codebase lacks modern coding conventions such as consistent naming, error handling, and logging practices. The modernization effort should address these areas to align with contemporary C# standards.

rules.rule: Use PascalCase for all public members and camelCase for private members.
examples: public class AccountType { public string AccountName { get; set; } }
counterexamples: public class accounttype { public string accountname { get; set; } }

rules.rule: Implement try-catch blocks for database operations.

lint_recommendations: Ensure all methods have XML documentation comments.
scaffold_templates: Use ASP.NET Core templates for web services.
